literal: Even for a single moment, their living, they do not know; (yet) they think of ten million and more other many things.
translation: Those who do not even know if they will live for another moment plan for ten million things and more.
modern: ஒரு நிமிடம் கூடத் தாங்கள் உயிர் வாழ்வதை உறுதி செய்யத் தெரியாதவர்கள், கோடிக்கும் மேலான பல எண்ணங்களை எண்ணித் திட்டமிடுகிறார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the profound ignorance of human beings regarding the impermanence of life. The poet points out that people cannot guarantee their own survival even for a single moment (orupozhutu). Yet, despite this extreme uncertainty, their minds are constantly occupied with planning and desiring millions of things (kotiyum alla pala) for the future. The contrast between the fragility of a single moment of life and the vastness of human desires emphasizes the theme of impermanence.
